items.name: Long Sen Yuan Hotpot
items.th: หลงเซินหยวน
items.atSource: Ctrip gaodeCoord, https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/5233731.html (Michelin pin converts to within 1 m)
items.photoCredit: Jpatokal · CC BY-SA 4.0 (hotpot, not this restaurant)
items.note: Old-style Chengdu hotpot a short walk south of the hotel on Qintai Road. Michelin picks the Emei eel-shred pot (峨眉鳝丝锅), spicy rabbit belly and brown-sugar ciba; it is busy, so expect to wait at peak times.
items.addr: 成都市青羊区琴台路60号

items.name: Mao Jiao Huo La skewers
items.th: เม่าเจียวหั่วล่า
items.photoCredit: Alpha from Melbourne · CC BY-SA 2.0 (cold-pot skewers, not this shop)
items.note: Cold-pot skewer (冷锅串串) institution on Kuixinglou Street, near Kuanzhai Alley. Order the Huanhou rabbit kidneys (桓侯兔腰), braised quail eggs and rabbit head; open 11:00–22:00, and there is usually a queue.
tags: Dianping Must-Eat 8+ years in a row

items.name: Houtang Hotpot
items.zh: 吼堂老火锅(太古里总店)
items.th: โหว่ถังเหล่าหั่วกัว
items.photoCredit: Breaknet2025 · CC BY 4.0 (split-pot hotpot, not this restaurant)
items.note: Three floors dressed as old Chengdu, five minutes from Chunxi Road metro, open until 2 am. Get a split pot and the fresh tripe, crab-roe shrimp paste and crispy pork (酥肉); queues are long at lunch and dinner, so go late.
items.addr: 成都市东大街下东大街段166号1-3层

items.name: Yu Zhi Lan
items.th: ยวี่จือหลาน
items.atSource: Ctrip gaodeCoord, https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/5238621.html (Michelin pin converts to within 1 m)
items.photoCredit: ZhengZhou · CC BY-SA 4.0 (red-oil dumplings, a dish on its menu; not taken here)
items.note: Chef Lan Guijun's low-key two-star tasting room behind a plain door on Changfa Street. Set menus only, built around his hair-thin gold-thread noodles (金丝面); book well ahead, and a Ctrip reviewer says half is paid as a deposit.
items.addr: 成都市青羊区长发街24号附1号

items.name: Chen Mapo Tofu (Qinghua Road)
items.th: เฉินหมาผัวโต้วฟู
items.atSource: Michelin pin converted from WGS-84, https://guide.michelin.com/sg/zh_CN/chengdu-municipality/chengdu/restaurant/chen-mapo-tofu-qinghua-road; Ctrip's gaodeCoord (https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/5233638.html) is 130 m off, inside a college campus, so not used
items.photoCredit: Kos88 · CC BY-SA 4.0 (mapo tofu at Chen Mapo)
items.note: The flagship of the shop that claims to have invented mapo tofu, near Du Fu Cottage. Order the stone-pot mapo tofu with rice, Zhong dumplings and lotus-leaf steamed pork; it is often full at mealtimes.
items.addr: 成都市青羊区青华路10号附10-12号

items.name: The Woo's
items.th: อู๋ซื่อฮุ่ย
items.atSource: Michelin pin converted from WGS-84, https://guide.michelin.com/sg/zh_CN/chengdu-municipality/chengdu/restaurant/the-woo-s (Michelin pins match Ctrip GCJ to 2 m elsewhere)
items.photoCredit: Kaisery · CC BY-SA 4.0 (brown-sugar ciba, not taken here)
items.note: Modernised Sichuan cooking in a restored three-storey old villa, about 1.5 km south-east of Taikoo Li. Michelin recommends the chilli-smothered yellow croaker (炝锅舟山海捕黄鱼) and molten ciba for dessert.
items.addr: 成都市锦江区宏济中路39号附17号

items.name: Long Chao Shou (Chunxi Road flagship)
items.th: หลงเชาโส่ว
items.atSource: Ctrip gaodeCoord, https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/4926065.html (OSM node for 龙抄手 on 联升巷 is 40 m away)
items.photoCredit: Alpha from Melbourne · CC BY-SA 2.0 (Long Chao Shou open kitchen)
items.note: Wonton house founded in 1941, a block from Chunxi Road. Order the sour-spicy chaoshou (酸辣龙抄手) or a small bowl in clear broth; the ground floor is noisy and upstairs sells set menus per head.

items.name: Dongzikou Zhang Lao Er Liangfen
items.zh: 洞子口张老二凉粉(文殊院店)
items.th: ต้งจึโข่วจางเหล่าเอ้อร์เหลียงเฝิ่น
items.atSource: Ctrip gaodeCoord, https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/5233829.html (OSM node at 文殊院街39号 converts to within 2 m)
items.photoCredit: MNXANL · CC BY-SA 4.0 (liangfen in Sichuan dressing, not taken here)
items.note: Old snack shop across from Wenshu Monastery. Order the sweet water noodles (甜水面), yellow or white liangfen and brown-sugar ice jelly (冰粉); queue to pay at the counter first, then share tables.

items.name: No. 37 Lao Yuanba Chaoshou
items.th: ซานสือชีเฮ่าเหล่าย่วนป้าเชาโส่ว
items.atSource: Michelin pin converted from WGS-84, https://guide.michelin.com/sg/zh_CN/chengdu-municipality/chengdu/restaurant/no-37-lao-yuan-ba-chao-shou (no Ctrip page found)
items.photoCredit: NeoBatfreak · CC BY-SA 4.0 (red-oil chaoshou, not taken here)
items.note: Husband-and-wife shop on Mawangmiao Street, about 1 km south of Wenshu Monastery. Order the dry-tossed chaoshou (干拌抄手) and the house sweet water noodles, choosing your spice level.
items.addr: 成都市青羊区马王庙街37号2栋

items.name: Gan Ji Feichang Fen
items.zh: 甘记肥肠粉(马鞍北路店)
items.th: กานจี้เฝยฉางเฝิ่น
items.atSource: Ctrip gaodeCoord, https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/4926191.html (Michelin pin converts to within 2 m)
items.photoCredit: Jpatokal · CC BY-SA 4.0 (sweet-potato noodles with pork intestine, not taken here)
items.note: Breakfast-to-dinner noodle shop with a blue sign, about 1.4 km east of Wenshu Monastery. Order the spicy pork-intestine noodles (红味肥肠粉) with an extra 冒节子 and a pork guokui flatbread; there is often a long line.
items.addr: 成都市金牛区马鞍北路18号附1-3号

items.name: Wan San Noodles
items.th: ว่านซานเมี่ยนกว่าน
items.atSource: Michelin pin converted from WGS-84, https://guide.michelin.com/sg/zh_CN/chengdu-municipality/chengdu/restaurant/wan-san-mian-guan-jinjiang (no Ctrip page found)
items.photoCredit: N509FZ · CC BY-SA 4.0 (Yibin ranmian, not taken here)
items.note: Yibin-style noodle shop about 1 km south of Taikoo Li. Order the ranmian (燃面) with ginger duck or fresh-chilli beef topping; most of the cured meats only come out after 18:00, so come in the evening.
items.addr: 成都市锦江区青龙正街131号附1号

items.name: Heming Teahouse, People's Park
items.th: เฮ่อหมิงฉาเซ่อ
items.atSource: Ctrip gaodeCoord, https://you.ctrip.com/food/chengdu104/5233721.html (OSM cafe node converts to within 30 m)
items.note: Lakeside teahouse in People's Park, open since 1923, a 20-minute walk from the hotel. Order a gaiwan of jasmine tea (花毛峰) or Mengding; reviewers put a cup at ¥13–30, and the shady seats fill early in the morning.

items.name: Lai Tangyuan
items.th: ไล่ทางหยวน
items.note: Century-old sweet dumpling shop on Zongfu Road at the north end of Chunxi Road. Order the mixed tangyuan with the dipping sauce served alongside; it also sells Zhong dumplings and other snacks, open 08:00–23:00.
